# SAKI

> SAKI (Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation) learns object-centric manipulation skills from one human video per skill, binds them to new scenes, and assembles them into long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks executed with whole-body kinematic imitation and visual feedback. Paper: arXiv:2609.36031 (cs.RO, 28 September 2026). Authors: Yijie Lu and James Zhao (equal contribution), Weiming Zhi (corresponding), The University of Sydney.

The project page is a single HTML page with video. The Markdown version below has every claim, video description, figure caption, film chapter and the full film transcript in plain text.
